title: Sinan
text: A unified embedding model built on Qwen-3.5-9B for image, video and visual-document retrieval. I was responsible for building a unified multimodal training and inference codebase, hard-negative mining, multi-source training, video sampling and model ensembling.
note: Our model achieved a higher average retrieval score on MMEB v2 than Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B, the state-of-the-art model at the time.

title: ASC26 · Systems for AI & Science
text: Optimized numerical-relativity workloads with MPI + OpenMP, AVX-512, data-layout changes and kernel fusion. Also contributed to world-model inference optimization with attention caching, mixed precision and dual-GPU execution.
note: 4.33× end-to-end speedup on AMSS-NCKU (RMS error <1%); 3.72–7.58× on world-model inference under the PSNR constraint.
